On Fri, Jun 11, 2026 at 9:03 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Monica — can you own temporary PO assignment + confirm spend-cap split?

Thanks — taking this. I reviewed Acme's intake and ran into two issues we need to correct before we can mint a provisional PO:

1) Line item mapping:
   - The "Edge CPU hours" row is currently split across two internal SKUs in their sheet (edge_compute vs edge_compute_bulk). We should consolidate that to a single charge line (edge_compute) and move the bulk usage into the support/overage bucket.
   - The "Support - onboarding" line was missing the quantity unit; intake shows a flat fee but the ledger expects a per-hour charge.

2) Spend cap routing:
   - Acme requested a single $30k cap. For accounting, we need that split across two cost centers: ENG-PILOT (70%) and CS-ONBOARD (30%). That yields ENG-PILOT = $21,000; CS-ONBOARD = $9,000.

Action I took:
- Attached a corrected intake sheet that normalizes the two line items and adds the missing billing codes. (Attachment: Acme_lineitem_fix.xlsx)
- I preliminarily reserved PO serial PO-2026-3417 as a provisional reference; holding it in the staging pool until Elena confirms the billing code and quantity normalization.

Please confirm that approach. If Elena confirms today, I will finalize the PO stub and push it out (PO-stub attached once finalized).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
